status: BUILD COMPLETE — host-only. `pinned_at_build` is filled: the toolchain, the console UART and the application image hash are pinned, and the watchdog is off for session 1 by the owner's ruling. This manifest still authorises nothing: the rulings (`whole-of-probe P3-L5`, `provisioning P3-K`) and board contact remain the owner's, after the post-build package is reviewed.

carrier.note: the short form is the one used in prose; the authoritative full hash is builds/p3/carrier_manifest.json

genome.note: N = 256 is review #2's Q7 condition, discharged; the C twin reproduces every entry's candidate_sha256 and sequence_sha256 (tests/test_firmware_twin.py)

memory_map.attributes: every instrument buffer is mapped strongly-ordered, non-cacheable by the application before first touch; no per-operation cache maintenance

protocol.transport: T1 — console (UART) with the runner as relay

session.brackets: opening baseline (blank candidate) → candidates → closing baseline (= restore) → closing unsigned ARM

pinned_at_build.app_image_final_because: the owner's watchdog ruling (option 2, watchdog-off) required no firmware change; the image was rebuilt after the ruling and is byte-identical, so this hash is final rather than provisional

console_uart.source: D1 spec T1 (the console = UART1) + every 17A6 board run's relay; not guessed

pinned_at_build.watchdog_status: NOT USED — session 1 runs watchdog-off (owner's ruling on D-c, 2026-08-31). P3_WDT_LOAD is 0 in the image and unreachable: the firmware gates both the arm and the kick on identity_page flags.bit1, which this session writes as 0.

identity_page_flags.note: the session's identity page MUST NOT declare the watchdog enabled. Flipping bit1 alone is forbidden: the load is 0, i.e. an immediate timeout. Enabling the watchdog is a firmware change (a prescaler write) with its own build, preregistration and ruling.

watchdog_finding.why_it_could_not_be_30_s: the 32-bit A9 private watchdog at PERIPHCLK=333.33 MHz with prescaler 0 tops out at 12.88 s; p3_app.c programs no prescaler and the driver exposes no SetPrescaler. See docs/l5_findings.md §4.
watchdog_finding.peripheral_clock_note: = CPU_6x4x/2; CPU_6x4x assumes the standard 6:2:1 ratio — ARM PLL 1333.33 MHz is board-confirmed, CPU_CLK_CTRL (0xF8000120) was never captured. Pre-board preflight, not a build blocker: nothing in a watchdog-off session depends on it.

if_ever_enabled.requires: a p3_app.c control-register write, a new build, a new prereg and a new ruling

preflight_before_board: md.l 0xF8000120 1 (CPU_CLK_CTRL) once at first power-on, stored with the session evidence; until then CPU_6x4x/PERIPHCLK are assumed, and no timing conversion derived from them may be reported as verified fact
pinned_at_build.note: COMPLETE. toolchain, console_uart and app_image_sha256 are pinned; the watchdog is deliberately off for session 1 and its load value is therefore not used rather than unset. Host recovery for a watchdog-off session is fixed in docs/l5_prereg.md §4.
